main_text.p: שָׁפִי Ch. Idem. בלב שפי Corde contrito, humili, Num. 23.3. in T.Hierof. vel corde uno,concordi,pacifico, Sic Genef.22.8.Plur.fœmin. לִיתְהוֹן שְׁפִין Non sunt sic tranquillæ, Genef.31.2.&5.in Jon.
שְׁפִין Ch. Lagana,Placentæ, Exod.16.31.in Targ.Hier. Guido legit שְׁפִנִין, & explicat Saccharum.
שְׁפִיוּתָא Ch. Emplastrum, Genef.3.16.in Targ.Ionat. Targ. Hierofhabet שְׁפוּיּתָא.
שִׁפֵּךְ Ch. Fundere, effundere, Psalm.104.7. Ithpeh. אשתפךְ Effusus fuit, Psal. 79.10.
שְׁפִיכוּרָא Ch. Effusio, Genef.28.20.in Jon. Levit.1.16. in Targ. Hierof.
מִשְׁפַּךְ Chald Effusio: decursus, locus declivis, Deut.3. 17. Jos.10.40.

שָׁפַל Hebr. Humiliari,deprimi,humilem,depres-sum, demissum esse. Aphel אַשְׁפִּיל Chald. Humiliare, demittere, dejicere, deprimere. Pahel ܐܫܦܠ Syr. Idem, Actor. 19.16. Ithpahel אִשְׁתַּפַּל Humiliari, Humiliare, Demittere, Dejicere, Incurvare se, 1. Sam. 2.36.
שְׁפוֹל Chal. Planities, humilis, declivis locus, locus aut pars cujuscunque rei inferior vel exterior. Plural.
